method.comparison: Baseline marks first six raw positive native contexts. Existing app paired mark is included in the common additive baseline for held comparisons. All new arms mark exact verified later target only and have zero whole-document weight.
method.isolation: Reused native cohorts previously tested for other methods. The 15 work selection panel is disjoint from all held works by work, recorded author and normalized 12-word fingerprint. Journal holdout differs by generator family; fresh holdout differs by work and includes a wider changed-band geometry. No fresh generation or source upload.
method.lexical: Lower-case word Levenshtein normalized by the longer sequence. Compare additive matches at the same held ordinary false-group count, including ties, as a diagnostic only.
method.lower_density: Increase in share of closed-class tokens from exact earlier to later targets. Existing local English word tokenizer and closed-class dictionary; numbers count in denominator.
method.paired_extension: Keep current model-specific doubled odds on one complete native input per view, taking the exact shared immediate flanks and all changed sentences inside the same paragraph. Require all app word/punctuation hunks contained in the verified target in both versions and changed tokens on both sides. The added lane accepts exactly a wider two-sentence or one-to-two shape that the app cannot currently compare. Existing scope and status stay separate.
method.review: At least two additional correctly located source groups with useful additions from at least two families, preserve every common-baseline useful location and at most two additional ordinary groups total. A grammar arm must also beat the lexical diagnostic at its own ordinary group count. Paired extension is judged in its separately reported newly eligible held subgroup, with per-cohort ordinary burden and attrition disclosed.
method.rule: Fit one genuine-only point per fixed feature from the 15 selection work maxima, using strict exceedance of the second-highest. Do not use generated selection scores or choose a method based on held results.
method.scope: The grammar arms mark only source-bound earlier/later interior target geometry. Complete one- or two-sentence earlier and later target, identical immediate flanks and unchanged prefix/suffix, same paragraph within each excerpt, exact native character slices; existing short-English cap. A shape with no verified band abstains. Known earlier revisions in their exact same-version comparison are ordinary self-controls.
method.skeleton: Levenshtein distance on exact target closed-class categories, OTHER words and number class, divided by Levenshtein distance on lower-case words, with zero on unchanged word sequence. Tests how edit allocation differs from lexical edit amount.
method.useful: Non-whitespace character IoU at least .30 and recall at least .50. Count ordinary flags by distinct work, include genuine earlier and revised roles, separate earlier and revised in subgroup readback.

method_clarification.frontier: Count false groups as the union of unchanged and revised ordinary flags, including the common baseline. A useful addition is against the common baseline on the identical held scope. Compute the maximum additions for lexical strict points using every recorded unique lexical threshold, including an all-admitted sentinel, at or below the same false-group budget. This is diagnostic and never a release operating point.
method_clarification.primary_eligibility: Restrict held decision counts for grammatical cues and the lexical comparator to the separately frozen native_band flag, which requires same-paragraph context in both versions. Keep all 15 selection works in threshold calculation and disclose 3 transcribed cross-paragraph calibration works. A geometry-only evaluation without that flag is diagnostic.
method_clarification.public_output: Exact source excerpts, function-word sequences, generated prose and raw logits remain local. Public evidence uses hashed case commitments, counts, final scalar responses and committed normalized positions.
method_clarification.wide_eligibility: Existing app paired evidence is added to all reported baselines. The two-sentence extension uses all cases in the later held cohort as its denominator and separately shows newly eligible generated and ordinary cases. The older journal cohorts have no wider targets.
